BiblicalUsage: Yallepheth is a scurf or scab, a skin condition named in the laws for priests and offerings. A man with such a blemish could not serve at the altar, and an animal so marked could not be offered to the LORD.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God cares about wholeness in His worship, and the outward blemish points to the inward cleanness He requires.
